hero.summary: A cinematic first-pass recreation of WOW Media's immersive homepage language, rebuilt in Nuxt 3 with fixture-backed content, bold editorial typography, and a live 3D hero scene.
hero.kicker: Out-of-home media, reimagined as destination-scale presence.

statements.title: When the environment becomes the media plan, every glance turns into momentum.
statements.body: The reference site treats scale, atmosphere, and placement as the product. This demo mirrors that pacing with compressed messaging, oversized contrast, and wide dark surfaces.

statements.title: Blue-lit systems, sculptural motion, and full-bleed storytelling shape the brand experience.
statements.body: Instead of a conventional grid-led agency site, the composition feels like a controlled environment. The recreated sections keep that feeling while using a manageable local component system.

capabilities.title: Spectacular Domes
capabilities.description: Hero-scale placements shaped as landmarks rather than units, presented with immersive motion and nighttime atmosphere.

capabilities.title: Corridor Networks
capabilities.description: Sequenced inventory across high-intensity movement paths, translated here into modular content and active media state.

capabilities.title: Moments of Arrival
capabilities.description: High-contrast placements that frame anticipation, tuned for premium brands that need more than passive visibility.

featuredMedia.title: EON Dome
featuredMedia.subtitle: Immersive district anchor
featuredMedia.detail: A luminous centerpiece with slow orbital motion and deep blue bloom, used here as the hero's visual metaphor.

featuredMedia.title: Ribbon Boards
featuredMedia.subtitle: Directional city framing
featuredMedia.detail: Continuous surfaces with linked state transitions, represented in the media rail as the active content sequence.

featuredMedia.title: Arrival Screens
featuredMedia.subtitle: Precision at scale
featuredMedia.detail: A sharper, denser moment in the page rhythm where information resolves into a premium contact point.

contact.title: Make the city feel booked.
contact.body: This demo stays focused on the first impression: a cinematic dark interface, bold type, strong blue accents, and a modular architecture ready for real CMS content later.
